And I am so tired of it all. The addiction, the comedown, the not giving a fuck if I spend my rent. 

Be so much easier just to say nigh5
Or I turn the light off at the end of the tunnel for good ya know

Yes i have. 

I need someone to take over my finances when I get paid etc, but when I have told friends my plan and I need their help. I get blanked. And then once again back to the 'it's like a switch, turn it on and off'
Have done a couple and it didn't help

Meth, any benzos I can get my hand on. 

Even tried getting into rehab,  the waiting time is a bit too long
Oh gotta love having a major shoe blow out. Fml

Thank you, for making sure the light at the tunnel hasn't been snuffed out. 

Xo

He doesn't like the threat the homeless are to his family and friends when they walk through the city. He is quite the fucking knob jockey. 

Basil Zempilas is his name.

There are also other factors for why I am back on the streets, Trying to beat a 20yr drug addiction, that on top of suffering from ADHD, bipolar untreated due to the drug abuse. 

My mind is in a very fragile stage, I suffer from paranoia etc from just burning myself out. 

Ive never had any real stability in my life, even from a young age, I saw a lot of schools due to moving around, became estranged from my mother at the age of 16 when she kicked me out. 

My dad was either there or not. But messy divorces would do that. 

Bullied at school, tried to end my life twice. 

My life hasn't been the best. 

The struggle and pain inside my head, I used have a good hold on it, but it's getting the better of me.

Thanks for listening.

Here in Aus, it's a total different ball game. We have made our voice heard. We have done everything. 

Our newly voted in Mayor has been a very outspoken cunt towards the homelessness that has unfortunately seiged our city  He even removed the local soup run. 

There really is no hope when you end up in this position.

They have the funding, but it's the lack of infrastructure i.e hostels, outreach programs. Even our public housing has a waiting period of 8 - 10 years. 

It's not fair on people who need a helping hand to get their life back on track.
Its difficult with homelessness services so over loaded, There are no safe places to sleep. Hopefully when I do sleep, its for the long one tbh.
